---
title: "About"
---

AEIS (the Aerospace Environmental Impacts Simulation group, pronounced "ace") is a research group within the Department of Aeronautics, Faculty of Engineering, at Imperial. We use models and observations to understand and reduce the impacts of aviation on the environment.

You can find more information about AEIS, our members, and what we get up to on our [Imperial webpage](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/aerospace-environmental-impacts/).

Information on group meetings can be found [here](group-meetings.qmd). 

## People

AEIS has two permanent staff members:

- **Seb** is the group leader.
- **Manuela** is our project manager who oversees some of the projects in the group and generally keeps us organised.

AEIS has a Junior Leadership Team (JLT) with three roles, each supported by a deputy:

- **Group Meetings**: The Group Meetings lead organises group meetings and socials.
    - **Lead**: Marek
    - **Deputy**: Caleb
- **Data & Computation**: The Data & Computation lead promotes good data storage and computation practices and works with the Sustainability lead to audit the group's hardware, compute, and data resources.
    - **Lead**: Hamid
    - **Deputy**: Uttam
- **Sustainability**: The Sustainability lead encourages environmentally sustainable practices within the group, works with the Data & Computation lead to audit the group's hardware, compute, and data resources, and pursues [Green DiSC](https://www.software.ac.uk/GreenDiSC) certification.
    - **Lead**: Jack
    - **Deputy**: Gavin

The JLT is appointed by Seb.
